# PlanMyNord

> PlanMyNord is a Norway travel planning website with suggested itineraries, maps, budget estimates, city guides and flight search links.

The website supports Norwegian, English and Russian. Its primary travel region is Norway.

Travel costs, distances and durations are estimates, not guarantees. Check current prices, opening hours, road conditions and ferry schedules with the relevant providers. Flight search links lead to external services; they are not confirmed fares or bookings.

Use the public pages below for summaries and references. Private account, profile, admin and payment pages are not public reference material.

## Travel Planning

- [Home](https://planmynord.com/): Overview of PlanMyNord.
- [Trip planner](https://planmynord.com/planner.html): Build a suggested itinerary with stops, dates, travellers and a budget.
- [Ready routes](https://planmynord.com/routes.html): Browse routes and open them in the planner.
- [City guides and things to do](https://planmynord.com/things.html): Places to visit and practical information.
- [Flights to Norway](https://planmynord.com/tickets.html): Prepare flight search links for external comparison services.
- [About the project](https://planmynord.com/about.html): Project information, data sources and limitations.
- [About the developer](https://planmynord.com/me.html): Kyrylo Hladuntsov, his projects, learning and homelab.
